topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The news came to me as the evening sun was sinking, casting long shadows over the fields. It seems a young lad, one who once spent his days in the village schoolhouse, has sent a gift to the old teacher who taught him letters and numbers. A token of gratitude, they say, for all that was shared. The teacher, an old man now, with winter settling in his bones, was moved by this. I’ve heard he keeps the gift close, as if it were a treasure from the past, a reminder of seasons when the earth was full of promise. The day was already long, and the thought of such kindness made the weight of the plow feel heavier on my shoulders. The village speaks of it, and in the silence, I wonder what tokens will be left of my own toil, come the frost.
